name: Heidi Dellaire
reason: Re-read under the 12 Nov health rule (heididellaire.com, robots open, 12 Nov 2026). Her work is anxiety and grief 'emotional health' coaching, not a spiritual practice of her own, and her Work With Me page sells the 1:1 coaching with 'You've read the books. You've done the therapy. And still, it stays.' (an indirect where-therapy-failed claim, treated as with Breethe and Ananta Ripa Ajmera). Her only course, 'Grief as a Doorway' (also run with The Shift Network), began 28 Oct with enrolment closed 8 Nov, so nothing current is left besides a podcast and a poetry book. Close call: the owner may prefer to list her for the podcast and the grief course's next cohort.
